The above conditions are being experienced in #Isabela(Tumauini, IlaganCity, Gamu, Quirino, DelfinAlbano, Cabagan, SantoTomas, SanPablo), #Apayao(Conner, Kabugao, Pudtol), #Abra(Tineg, Lacub, Lagayan, LicuanBaay and Malibcong) which may persist within 30 mins to 1 hour and may affect nearby areas.

Keep monitoring for updates.
